temperature.description: How much randomness goes into each word. Low keeps answers predictable and on-script; high makes them varied and less reliable. Mistral recommends 0.0 to 0.7. Defaults to 0.1, the value that was hardcoded before this field existed.

mark_aide.en: How much randomness goes into each word. Low keeps answers predictable and on-script; high makes them varied and less reliable. Mistral recommends 0.0 to 0.7. Defaults to 0.1, the value that was hardcoded before this field existed.
mark_aide.fr: Quantité de hasard dans chaque mot. Bas, les réponses restent prévisibles et fidèles au script ; haut, elles varient et deviennent moins fiables. Mistral recommande de 0,0 à 0,7. Vaut 0,1 par défaut, la valeur qui était fixée dans le code avant ce réglage.

temperature.title: Temperature

seed.description: Fixes the draw: two identical calls give back the same conversation. A laboratory tool for comparing two settings, not a production one. Left empty, each call is drawn afresh.

mark_aide.en: Fixes the draw: two identical calls give back the same conversation. A laboratory tool for comparing two settings, not a production one. Left empty, each call is drawn afresh.
mark_aide.fr: Fige le tirage : deux appels identiques redonnent la même conversation. Un outil de laboratoire pour comparer deux réglages, pas un réglage de production. Vide, chaque appel est tiré à nouveau.

seed.title: Seed

max_tokens.description: Longest answer the model may produce, in tokens (a token is roughly three quarters of a word). An answer half as long comes back about twice as fast, which is heard on the phone. WARNING: this ceiling also applies to the out-of-band call that fills in the call report, so a low value can truncate it and leave fields empty. Left empty, the model stops when it has finished.

mark_aide.en: Longest answer the model may produce, in tokens (a token is roughly three quarters of a word). An answer half as long comes back about twice as fast, which is heard on the phone. WARNING: this ceiling also applies to the out-of-band call that fills in the call report, so a low value can truncate it and leave fields empty. Left empty, the model stops when it has finished.
mark_aide.fr: Longueur maximale d'une réponse, en jetons (un jeton vaut à peu près les trois quarts d'un mot). Une réponse deux fois plus courte revient environ deux fois plus vite, et cela s'entend au téléphone. ATTENTION : ce plafond vaut aussi pour l'appel hors conversation qui remplit le compte rendu d'appel : une valeur basse peut le tronquer et laisser des champs vides. Vide, le modèle s'arrête quand il a fini.

max_tokens.title: Max Tokens

top_p.description: Restricts the draw to the most likely words: 0.1 keeps only the top 10% of the probability mass. Acts on the same phenomenon as temperature, so Mistral advises changing one or the other, not both. Above 0 and up to 1.

mark_aide.en: Restricts the draw to the most likely words: 0.1 keeps only the top 10% of the probability mass. Acts on the same phenomenon as temperature, so Mistral advises changing one or the other, not both. Above 0 and up to 1.
mark_aide.fr: Limite le tirage aux mots les plus probables : 0,1 ne garde que les 10 % de probabilité du haut. Agit sur le même phénomène que la température, Mistral conseille donc de régler l'un ou l'autre, pas les deux. Au-dessus de 0 et jusqu'à 1.

top_p.title: Top P

frequency_penalty.description: Discourages repeating a word already used often in the answer. From -2 to 2; positive values reduce repetition.

mark_aide.en: Discourages repeating a word already used often in the answer. From -2 to 2; positive values reduce repetition.
mark_aide.fr: Décourage de répéter un mot déjà très employé dans la réponse. De -2 à 2 ; une valeur positive réduit les répétitions.

frequency_penalty.title: Frequency Penalty

presence_penalty.description: Pushes the model towards subjects it has not brought up yet. From -2 to 2; positive values widen the range of topics.

mark_aide.en: Pushes the model towards subjects it has not brought up yet. From -2 to 2; positive values widen the range of topics.
mark_aide.fr: Pousse le modèle vers des sujets qu'il n'a pas encore abordés. De -2 à 2 ; une valeur positive élargit la gamme des sujets.

presence_penalty.title: Presence Penalty

adresse_libre.description: Free entry: accept any address scheme (https://, wss://, grpc://...) instead of the provider's own check. An address with no host is still refused.

mark_aide.en: Accepts any address scheme (wss://, https://, grpc://...) instead of the provider's own check. Only an address with no host is still refused. It is not « Enter Custom Value » above, which only lets you type an address that is not in the list.
mark_aide.fr: Accepte tout schéma d'adresse (wss://, https://, grpc://...) au lieu du contrôle propre au fournisseur. Seule une adresse sans hôte reste refusée. Ce n'est pas « Saisir une valeur personnalisée », au-dessus, qui permet seulement de taper une adresse absente de la liste.

base_url.description: The Deepgram endpoint the caller's audio is sent to, and therefore the jurisdiction that processes it. Defaults to Europe and can be changed: upstream defaults it to the global endpoint, .mark defaults it to the EU one. Leaving it empty also sends the audio to Europe.

mark_aide.en: The Deepgram endpoint the caller's audio is sent to, and therefore the jurisdiction that processes it. Defaults to Europe and can be changed: upstream defaults it to the global endpoint, .mark defaults it to the EU one. Leaving it empty also sends the audio to Europe.
mark_aide.fr: L'adresse Deepgram à laquelle l'audio de l'appelant est envoyé, donc la juridiction qui le traite. Par défaut l'Europe, et modifiable : l'amont met l'adresse mondiale par défaut, .mark met l'européenne. Vide, l'audio part aussi en Europe.

base_url.title: Base Url

endpointing.description: Silence, in milliseconds, after which Deepgram declares the speech finished. This is the setting that decides when the agent takes the floor, so it caps the responsiveness of the whole chain: too low and the agent cuts the caller off, too high and it leaves a blank. Deepgram's own default is 10 ms; 100 ms is the value that was hardcoded before this field existed. Deepgram also accepts 'false' to switch endpointing off entirely, which this field does not offer.

mark_aide.en: Silence, in milliseconds, after which Deepgram declares the speech finished. This is the setting that decides when the agent takes the floor, so it caps the responsiveness of the whole chain: too low and the agent cuts the caller off, too high and it leaves a blank. Deepgram's own default is 10 ms; 100 ms is the value that was hardcoded before this field existed. Deepgram also accepts 'false' to switch endpointing off entirely, which this field does not offer.
mark_aide.fr: Silence, en millisecondes, après lequel Deepgram déclare la parole terminée. C'est ce réglage qui décide quand l'agent prend la parole : il plafonne la réactivité de toute la chaîne. Trop bas, l'agent coupe l'appelant ; trop haut, il laisse un blanc. Le défaut de Deepgram est 10 ms ; 100 ms est la valeur qui était fixée dans le code avant ce réglage. Deepgram accepte aussi « false » pour couper entièrement la détection de fin de parole, ce que ce réglage ne propose pas.

endpointing.title: Endpointing

utterance_end_ms.description: Silence, in milliseconds, after which Deepgram emits an end-of-utterance event. From 1000 to 5000. WARNING: requires interim results to be on; without them Deepgram sends nothing. Left empty, no such event is requested, which is today's behaviour.

mark_aide.en: Silence, in milliseconds, after which Deepgram emits an end-of-utterance event. From 1000 to 5000. WARNING: requires interim results to be on; without them Deepgram sends nothing. Left empty, no such event is requested, which is today's behaviour.
mark_aide.fr: Silence, en millisecondes, après lequel Deepgram émet un événement de fin d'énoncé. De 1000 à 5000. ATTENTION : exige que les résultats intermédiaires soient allumés ; sans eux Deepgram n'envoie rien. Vide, aucun événement n'est demandé, ce qui est le comportement actuel.

utterance_end_ms.title: Utterance End Ms

interim_results.description: Sends partial transcriptions as the caller speaks, instead of only the finished sentence. On today by way of the connector's own default, and required by the end-of-utterance setting above.

mark_aide.en: Sends partial transcriptions as the caller speaks, instead of only the finished sentence. On today by way of the connector's own default, and required by the end-of-utterance setting above.
mark_aide.fr: Envoie des transcriptions partielles pendant que l'appelant parle, au lieu de la seule phrase terminée. Allumé aujourd'hui par le défaut du connecteur, et exigé par le réglage de fin d'énoncé ci-dessus.

interim_results.title: Interim Results

keywords.description: Words to boost, written 'word' or 'word:intensifier'. NOT supported from nova-3 onwards, where Deepgram replaced it with keyterm prompting — which is what the agent's Dictionary already feeds. Only shown when an older model is selected.

mark_aide.en: Words to boost, written 'word' or 'word:intensifier'. NOT supported from nova-3 onwards, where Deepgram replaced it with keyterm prompting — which is what the agent's Dictionary already feeds. Only shown when an older model is selected.
mark_aide.fr: Mots à renforcer, écrits « mot » ou « mot:intensité ». NON pris en charge à partir de nova-3, où Deepgram l'a remplacé par les mots-clés, ce que le dictionnaire de l'agent alimente déjà. Affiché seulement avec un modèle plus ancien.

keywords.title: Keywords

punctuate.description: Adds punctuation and capitalisation to the transcript. On today by way of the connector's own default. Required for dictation below to have any effect.

mark_aide.en: Adds punctuation and capitalisation to the transcript. On today by way of the connector's own default. Required for dictation below to have any effect.
mark_aide.fr: Ajoute ponctuation et majuscules à la transcription. Allumé aujourd'hui par le défaut du connecteur. Nécessaire pour que la dictée ci-dessous ait un effet.

punctuate.title: Punctuate

smart_format.description: Formats dates, times, phone numbers and amounts for readability. Includes the numerals setting below. Off today by way of the connector's own default.

mark_aide.en: Formats dates, times, phone numbers and amounts for readability. Includes the numerals setting below. Off today by way of the connector's own default.
mark_aide.fr: Met en forme les dates, heures, numéros de téléphone et montants pour la lisibilité. Inclut le réglage des chiffres ci-dessous. Éteint aujourd'hui par le défaut du connecteur.

smart_format.title: Smart Format

numerals.description: Writes spoken numbers as digits ('twenty three' becomes '23'). Off today by way of the connector's own default.

mark_aide.en: Writes spoken numbers as digits ('twenty three' becomes '23'). Off today by way of the connector's own default.
mark_aide.fr: Écrit les nombres dits en chiffres (« vingt-trois » devient « 23 »). Éteint aujourd'hui par le défaut du connecteur.

numerals.title: Numerals

dictation.description: Turns spoken punctuation commands into characters ('comma' becomes ','). WARNING: English only, and has no effect unless punctuation is on. Off today by way of the connector's own default.

mark_aide.en: Turns spoken punctuation commands into characters ('comma' becomes ','). WARNING: English only, and has no effect unless punctuation is on. Off today by way of the connector's own default.
mark_aide.fr: Transforme les commandes de ponctuation dites en caractères (« virgule » devient « , »). ATTENTION : anglais seulement, et sans effet si la ponctuation est éteinte. Éteint aujourd'hui par le défaut du connecteur.

dictation.title: Dictation

profanity_filter.description: Replaces or removes coarse language in the transcript. Off is the value that was hardcoded before this field existed: what the caller said reaches the agent as they said it.

mark_aide.en: Replaces or removes coarse language in the transcript. Off is the value that was hardcoded before this field existed: what the caller said reaches the agent as they said it.
mark_aide.fr: Remplace ou retire les gros mots de la transcription. Éteint est la valeur qui était fixée dans le code avant ce réglage : ce que l'appelant a dit parvient à l'agent tel quel.

profanity_filter.title: Profanity Filter

redact.description: Removes sensitive information from the transcript before it reaches us. Categories such as pci, pii, phi, numbers, aggressive_numbers, or an individual entity type. WARNING: outside English, only numbers are redacted. Left empty, nothing is redacted, which is today's behaviour.

mark_aide.en: Removes sensitive information from the transcript before it reaches us. Categories such as pci, pii, phi, numbers, aggressive_numbers, or an individual entity type. WARNING: outside English, only numbers are redacted. Left empty, nothing is redacted, which is today's behaviour.
mark_aide.fr: Retire les informations sensibles de la transcription avant qu'elle nous parvienne. Catégories comme pci, pii, phi, numbers, aggressive_numbers, ou un type d'entité précis. ATTENTION : hors de l'anglais, seuls les nombres sont masqués. Vide, rien n'est masqué, ce qui est le comportement actuel.

redact.title: Redact

replace.description: Replacement rules, written 'term heard:term written'. Useful for a trade word the model mishears consistently. One rule per entry; the colon separates the two halves.

mark_aide.en: Replacement rules, written 'term heard:term written'. Useful for a trade word the model mishears consistently. One rule per entry; the colon separates the two halves.
mark_aide.fr: Règles de remplacement, écrites « terme entendu:terme écrit ». Utile pour un mot du métier que le modèle comprend mal de façon constante. Une règle par entrée ; les deux-points séparent les deux moitiés.

replace.title: Replace

search.description: Terms Deepgram reports the position and confidence of, without changing the transcript. WARNING: nothing in the agent reads those results today, so this is an observation aid, not a behaviour.

mark_aide.en: Terms Deepgram reports the position and confidence of, without changing the transcript. WARNING: nothing in the agent reads those results today, so this is an observation aid, not a behaviour.
mark_aide.fr: Termes dont Deepgram rapporte la position et la confiance, sans changer la transcription. ATTENTION : rien dans l'agent ne lit ces résultats aujourd'hui, c'est donc une aide d'observation, pas un comportement.

search.title: Search

diarize.description: Labels the transcript by speaker. WARNING: Deepgram marks this parameter deprecated in favour of diarize_model, which the connector does not carry; it still works and routes to the v1 diarizer. On a telephone call the agent and the caller are already on separate channels, so there is little to gain.

mark_aide.en: Labels the transcript by speaker. WARNING: Deepgram marks this parameter deprecated in favour of diarize_model, which the connector does not carry; it still works and routes to the v1 diarizer. On a telephone call the agent and the caller are already on separate channels, so there is little to gain.
mark_aide.fr: Étiquette la transcription par locuteur. ATTENTION : Deepgram marque ce paramètre comme obsolète au profit de diarize_model, que le connecteur ne porte pas ; il marche encore et passe par l'ancien module. Au téléphone, l'agent et l'appelant sont déjà sur des canaux séparés : le gain est faible.

diarize.title: Diarize

detect_entities.description: Marks names, dates, amounts and the like in the transcript. WARNING: nothing in the agent reads those markers today. Off by way of the connector's own default.

mark_aide.en: Marks names, dates, amounts and the like in the transcript. WARNING: nothing in the agent reads those markers today. Off by way of the connector's own default.
mark_aide.fr: Repère dans la transcription les noms, dates, montants et autres. ATTENTION : rien dans l'agent ne lit ces repères aujourd'hui. Éteint par le défaut du connecteur.

detect_entities.title: Detect Entities

eot_threshold.description: Confidence Flux needs before it declares the turn finished. Low means turns end sooner, so the agent answers faster and cuts in more often; high means it waits for a complete sentence. From 0.5 to 1. Deepgram's default is 0.7, which is also the value that was hardcoded before this field existed.

mark_aide.en: Confidence Flux needs before it declares the turn finished. Low means turns end sooner, so the agent answers faster and cuts in more often; high means it waits for a complete sentence. From 0.5 to 1. Deepgram's default is 0.7, which is also the value that was hardcoded before this field existed.
mark_aide.fr: Confiance dont Flux a besoin pour déclarer le tour terminé. Basse, les tours se terminent plus tôt : l'agent répond plus vite et coupe plus souvent ; haute, il attend une phrase complète. De 0,5 à 1. Le défaut de Deepgram est 0,7, aussi la valeur qui était fixée dans le code avant ce réglage.

eot_threshold.title: Eot Threshold

eager_eot_threshold.description: Confidence at which Flux announces the turn is probably about to end, so the answer can be prepared before the caller has actually stopped. From 0.3 to 0.9, and it must stay at or below the threshold above. Deepgram leaves it off by default; 0.5 is the value that was hardcoded before this field existed.

mark_aide.en: Confidence at which Flux announces the turn is probably about to end, so the answer can be prepared before the caller has actually stopped. From 0.3 to 0.9, and it must stay at or below the threshold above. Deepgram leaves it off by default; 0.5 is the value that was hardcoded before this field existed.
mark_aide.fr: Confiance à laquelle Flux annonce que le tour va probablement se terminer, pour préparer la réponse avant que l'appelant ait vraiment fini. De 0,3 à 0,9, et elle doit rester inférieure ou égale au seuil ci-dessus. Deepgram la laisse éteinte par défaut ; 0,5 est la valeur qui était fixée dans le code avant ce réglage.

mark_libelle.fr: Seuil de fin de tour anticipée

eager_eot_threshold.title: Eager Eot Threshold

eot_timeout_ms.description: Silence, in milliseconds, after which Flux finishes the turn whatever its confidence. From 500 to 60000. Deepgram's default is 5000; 3000 is the value that was hardcoded before this field existed.

mark_aide.en: Silence, in milliseconds, after which Flux finishes the turn whatever its confidence. From 500 to 60000. Deepgram's default is 5000; 3000 is the value that was hardcoded before this field existed.
mark_aide.fr: Silence, en millisecondes, après lequel Flux termine le tour quelle que soit sa confiance. De 500 à 60000. Le défaut de Deepgram est 5000 ; 3000 est la valeur qui était fixée dans le code avant ce réglage.

mark_libelle.fr: Délai maximum de fin de tour (ms)

eot_timeout_ms.title: Eot Timeout Ms

language_hints.description: Languages to bias multilingual detection towards. Only the multilingual Flux model reads them. Left empty, the hint is derived from the language chosen above, which is what happens today; filled in, it replaces that derivation.

mark_aide.en: Languages to bias multilingual detection towards. Only the multilingual Flux model reads them. Left empty, the hint is derived from the language chosen above, which is what happens today; filled in, it replaces that derivation.
mark_aide.fr: Langues vers lesquelles orienter la détection multilingue. Seul le modèle Flux multilingue les lit. Vide, l'indice se déduit de la langue choisie plus haut, comme aujourd'hui ; rempli, il remplace cette déduction.

language_hints.title: Language Hints

min_confidence.description: Below this confidence, a finished turn is DROPPED and never reaches the agent, which then hears nothing at all. WARNING: this one is not sent to Deepgram; it is a filter applied on our side to what Deepgram returns. Left empty, nothing is dropped, which is today's behaviour.

mark_aide.en: Below this confidence, a finished turn is DROPPED and never reaches the agent, which then hears nothing at all. WARNING: this one is not sent to Deepgram; it is a filter applied on our side to what Deepgram returns. Left empty, nothing is dropped, which is today's behaviour.
mark_aide.fr: En dessous de cette confiance, un tour terminé est ÉCARTÉ et n'atteint jamais l'agent, qui n'entend alors rien du tout. ATTENTION : ce réglage n'est pas envoyé à Deepgram ; c'est un filtre appliqué de notre côté à ce que Deepgram rend. Vide, rien n'est écarté, ce qui est le comportement actuel.

min_confidence.title: Min Confidence

region.description: The Deepgram region the caller's audio is processed in. Derived from the endpoint above rather than chosen: change the endpoint and this follows. Defaults to Europe.

mark_aide.en: The Deepgram region the caller's audio is processed in. Derived from the endpoint above rather than chosen: change the endpoint and this follows. Defaults to Europe.
mark_aide.fr: La région Deepgram où l'audio de l'appelant est traité. Déduite de l'adresse ci-dessus plutôt que choisie : changez l'adresse et celle-ci suit. L'Europe par défaut.

region.title: Region

mip_opt_out.description: Refusal to take part in Deepgram's Model Improvement Program, so no call is used to train their models. Locked on: it is a condition of the offer, not an option. Refusing forfeits a discount, and that is accepted.

mark_aide.en: Refusal to take part in Deepgram's Model Improvement Program, so no call is used to train their models. Locked on: it is a condition of the offer, not an option. Refusing forfeits a discount, and that is accepted.
mark_aide.fr: Refus de participer au programme d'amélioration des modèles de Deepgram : aucun appel ne sert à entraîner leurs modèles. Verrouillé : c'est une condition de l'offre, pas une option. Refuser fait perdre une remise, et c'est accepté.

mark_libelle.fr: Refus du programme d'amélioration des modèles

mip_opt_out.title: Mip Opt Out

adresse_libre.description: Free entry: accept any address scheme (https://, wss://, grpc://...) instead of the provider's own check. An address with no host is still refused.

mark_aide.en: Accepts any address scheme (wss://, https://, grpc://...) instead of the provider's own check. Only an address with no host is still refused. It is not « Enter Custom Value » above, which only lets you type an address that is not in the list.
mark_aide.fr: Accepte tout schéma d'adresse (wss://, https://, grpc://...) au lieu du contrôle propre au fournisseur. Seule une adresse sans hôte reste refusée. Ce n'est pas « Saisir une valeur personnalisée », au-dessus, qui permet seulement de taper une adresse absente de la liste.
